glosses: square (a polygon with four straight sides of equal length and four right angles)
rectangle (any quadrilateral having opposing sides parallel and four right angles)
picture, painting or other work of art, especially one in a frame

examples.text: Hay muchos cuadros en la pared.
examples.en: There are many paintings on the wall.
How did you come by this painting?

examples.text: Mira el cuadro en la pared.
examples.en: Look at the picture on the wall.
